title: Tim's Cat
lines: Tim did not see his cat. "Cat, cat!" said Tim.
Dad and Tim look in the box. It is not in it.
"Is it up on the bed?" said Dad. Tim runs up.
The cat sits on his cap!
"You hid, cat," said Tim. He hugs it a lot.
The cat hums and lets him. Dad pats its tan legs.
"It is fun to see him," said Tim.
